description: Weekly batch on Monday, 04:00–05:59 Europe/Madrid. The schedule is the window in which Renovate may create pull requests, not a start time, so it has to be wide enough for a hosted run to land inside it: a single hour was too narrow, and a whole-day window is noisier than intended.

packageRules.description: The undici@6 and undici@7 overrides are security floors pinned per major line: undici@6 exists because @actions/http-client@4 declares undici: ^6.23.0, and undici@7 exists because @semantic-release/github@12 declares undici: ^7.0.0. Widening either range to a new major pushes an unsupported major through a dependent that still declares the old one, so raise a major by hand together with the parent bump.
